notes.title: Developer Update: What's on Our Workbench?
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have two pieces of news to share.

The first news is shrouded in mystery. We are working on a big game that’s far more ambitious than anything we’ve done before. We'd love to share more details, but it’s still too early. What’s important is that if you’re reading this, you’ll likely enjoy it :)

The second news is more niche. Over the past few months, we’ve created a small experimental game about fashion that we really like. It was initially quite experimental and ended up being so specialized that it appeals mainly to fans of fashion and the beloved roguelike genre. If you find yourself in this unique intersection, you might enjoy "The Great Couturier." And if you do, please leave a review on its page – it will help other fans of this (nonexistent?) genre discover the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850970/The_Great_Couturier/

That’s all for now. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Step into a Fairy Tale with the Fairytale Furnishing Demo - Available Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, Design Dreamers!! 

We’re excited to share that we’ve not only expanded upon the ideas from “Moving Through Life,” but also implemented several key decisions based on player feedback and our own creative insights. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2895090/Fairytale_Furnishing

There’s a lot that’s new, but let’s focus on the highlights:

[list]
[*] More Freedom: Fairytale Furnishing gives you the reins to place items wherever you wish, making the game feel more like a sandbox adventure.

[*] Save System: Unlike Moving Through Life, which only saved between levels, Fairytale Furnishing allows you to save your progress on each level, giving you the freedom to revisit and replay at any point, even after completion.

[*] Camera Control: We’ve introduced two camera control modes, catering to those who enjoy finding the perfect angle for both convenience and beauty.

[*] And most importantly: If Moving Through Life was a game about life’s journey, [b]Fairytale Furnishing invites you to dive into a fairy tale[/b].
[/list]

We’d be delighted if you try out the demo. And don’t forget to add Fairytale Furnishing to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2895090/Fairytale_Furnishing]your wishlist![/url]
